verses.en: Whereof do they question one another
(It is) of the awful tidings
Concerning which they are in disagreement
Nay, but they will come to know
Nay, again, but they will come to know
Have We not made the earth an expanse
And the high hills bulwarks
And We have created you in pairs
And have appointed your sleep for repose
And have appointed the night as a cloak
And have appointed the day for livelihood

verses.ar: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعࣰ ا شِدَادࣰ ا
verses.en: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens)
And have appointed a dazzling lamp

verses.ar: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءࣰ ثَجَّاجࣰ ا
verses.en: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water

verses.ar: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبࣰّ ا وَنَبَاتࣰ ا
verses.en: Thereby to produce grain and plant
And gardens of thick foliage

verses.ar: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتࣰ ا
verses.en: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجࣰ ا
verses.en: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes
And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates
And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage
Lo! hell lurketh in ambush
A home for the rebellious
They will abide therein for ages

verses.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدࣰ ا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.en: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
Save boiling water and a paralysing cold
Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds)

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابࣰ ا
verses.en: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning
They called Our revelations false with strong denial
Everything have We recorded in a Book
So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment
Lo! for the duteous is achievement
Gardens enclosed and vineyards
And voluptuous women of equal age
And a full cup

verses.ar: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوࣰ ا وَلَا كِذَّٰبࣰ ا
verses.en: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying

verses.ar: جَزَآءࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابࣰ ا
verses.en: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment

verses.ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابࣰ ا
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفࣰّ اۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابࣰ ا
verses.en: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.en: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابࣰ ا قَرِيبࣰ ا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
verses.en: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust
